cohort: 60 patients undergoing LSCS under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Both 10 and 15 mcg of nor-epinephrine were effective in preventing hypotension during spinal anaesthesia, with the 10 mcg bolus proving to be a good preventive measure with a reduced incidence of adverse effects compared to 15 mcg.
mod_finding: For patients undergoing LSCS under spinal anaesthesia, a 10 mcg bolus dose of nor-epinephrine was found to be an effective preventive measure against hypotension, with reduced adverse effects compared to a 15 mcg dose.
